title: Hitting a draw
description: Aim your body {right} and set the clubface a little closed to that line, pointing between your body line and the target.
tips: Aim your feet, hips and shoulders {right} of the target and swing along that line.
Set the clubface a little closed to your stance, pointing just {right} of the target.
Ball starts {right} and curves gently back to the target.
A draw flies a touch lower and runs out more after landing.
